function initHeroSlider(){
 if(window.__heroSliderTimer){clearInterval(window.__heroSliderTimer);window.__heroSliderTimer=null;}
 const root=document.querySelector('[data-hero-slider]');
 if(!root) return;
 const slides=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-hero-slide]')];
 const dots=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-slide-to]')];
 const prev=root.querySelector('[data-slide-prev]');
 const next=root.querySelector('[data-slide-next]');
 let current=0;
 const show=index=>{
   current=(index+slides.length)%slides.length;
   slides.forEach((slide,i)=>slide.classList.toggle('active',i===current));
   dots.forEach((dot,i)=>dot.classList.toggle('active',i===current));
 };
 const start=()=>{ if(window.__heroSliderTimer) clearInterval(window.__heroSliderTimer); window.__heroSliderTimer=setInterval(()=>show(current+1),5000); };
 const stop=()=>{ if(window.__heroSliderTimer){clearInterval(window.__heroSliderTimer);window.__heroSliderTimer=null;} };
 dots.forEach((dot,i)=>dot.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(i); start();}));
 if(prev) prev.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(current-1); start();});
 if(next) next.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(current+1); start();});
 root.addEventListener('mouseenter',stop);
 root.addEventListener('mouseleave',start);
 root.addEventListener('touchstart',stop,{passive:true});
 root.addEventListener('touchend',start,{passive:true});
 show(0); start();
}

function initTeamSlider(){

 const root=document.querySelector('[data-team-slider]');
 if(!root) return;
 const slides=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-team-slide]')];
 const dots=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-team-dot]')];

 const next=root.querySelector('[data-team-next]');
 let current=0;
 const show=index=>{
   current=(index+slides.length)%slides.length;
   slides.forEach((slide,i)=>slide.classList.toggle('active',i===current));
   dots.forEach((dot,i)=>dot.classList.toggle('active',i===current));
 };
 const start=()=>{if(window.__teamSliderTimer) clearInterval(window.__teamSliderTimer); window.__teamSliderTimer=setInterval(()=>show(current+1),4200);};
 const stop=()=>{if(window.__teamSliderTimer){clearInterval(window.__teamSliderTimer);window.__teamSliderTimer=null;}};
 dots.forEach((dot,i)=>dot.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(i);start();}));
 if(prev) prev.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(current-1);start();});
 if(next) next.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(current+1);start();});
 root.addEventListener('mouseenter',stop);
 root.addEventListener('mouseleave',start);
 root.addEventListener('touchstart',stop,{passive:true});
 root.addEventListener('touchend',start,{passive:true});
 show(0); start();
}

function render(){
 const hash = location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '') || 'home';
 const parts = hash.split('/').filter(Boolean);
 const requestedPage = parts[0] || 'home';
 const requestedSub = parts.slice(1).join('/');

 // Direct route check for founders message
 if (requestedPage === 'founders-message' || requestedSub === 'founders-message' || hash.includes('founders-message') || hash.includes('founder-message')) {
  document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = header() + `<main id="main">${foundersMessage()}</main>` + footer();
  document.title = "Founder's Message | Jai Kisaan Solar";
  wire();
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'});
  return;
 }

 if (['impact','resources','news','support'].includes(requestedPage)) {
  location.hash = '#/home';
  return;
 }

 const page = requestedPage;
 const sub = requestedSub;
 let content = '';
 switch(page){
  case 'home': content = home(); break;
  case 'about': content = about(sub); break;
  case 'solutions': content = solutions(sub); break;
  case 'projects': content = projects(sub); break;
  case 'partners': content = partners(sub); break;
  case 'investors': content = investors(sub); break;
  case 'careers': content = careers(sub); break;
  case 'contact': content = contact(sub); break;
  case 'privacy': content = legal('Privacy Policy'); break;
  case 'terms': content = legal('Terms & Conditions'); break;
  default: content = home();
 }

 document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = header() + `<main id="main">${content}</main>` + footer();
 document.title = (nav.find(n => n.slug === page)?.name || 'Jai Kisaan Solar') + ' | Jai Kisaan Solar';
 wire();
 window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'});
 if(page === 'home'){ updateCalculator(); initHeroSlider(); }
 if(page === 'about'){ initTeamSlider(); }
 if(page === 'solutions' && sub === 'faqs'){
  requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById('solar-faq')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant', block:'start'}));
 }
}

function wire(){
 const menu=document.getElementById('main-nav');
 const mobile=document.getElementById('mobile-toggle');
 if(mobile && menu){
  mobile.onclick=()=>{
   let next=!menu.classList.contains('mobile-open');
   menu.classList.toggle('mobile-open',next);
   mobile.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(next));
   mobile.textContent=next?'✕':'☰';
  };
 }

 // Close mobile menu and handle dropdown clicks
 document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown a').forEach(a=>{
  a.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
   if(menu) menu.classList.remove('mobile-open');
   if(mobile){ mobile.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); mobile.textContent='☰'; }
   document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(ni=>ni.classList.remove('open'));
   const target = a.getAttribute('href');
   if(target && target.startsWith('#/')){
    if(location.hash === target){
     render();
    }
   }
  });
 });

 document.querySelectorAll('[data-goto]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const n=b.closest('.nav-item'),has=n?n.querySelector('.dropdown'):null;
  if(!has){
   const target = route(b.dataset.goto);
   if(location.hash === target){ render(); } else { location.hash = target; }
   return;
  }
  if(window.matchMedia('(max-width:1020px)').matches){
   let open=n.classList.toggle('open');
   b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
  }else{
   const target = route(b.dataset.goto);
   if(location.hash === target){ render(); } else { location.hash = target; }
  }
 }));

 document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#/"]').forEach(a=>{
  a.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
   const target = a.getAttribute('href');
   if(location.hash === target){
    render();
   }
  });
 });

 document.querySelectorAll('form.lead-form').forEach(f=>f.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  if(!f.reportValidity())return;
  const d=new FormData(f);
  let lines=['Hello Jai Kisaan Solar, I would like to submit an enquiry.','',`Name: ${d.get('name')}`,`Phone: ${d.get('phone')}`,`Email: ${d.get('email')||'Not provided'}`,`City: ${d.get('city')}`,`Requirement: ${d.get('requirement')}`,`Monthly bill range: ${d.get('bill')||'Not specified'}`,`Details: ${d.get('details')||'Not provided'}`,`Source: Website / ${f.dataset.type}`];
  const url=WA+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(lines.join('\n'));
  const feedback=f.querySelector('.form-feedback');
  if(feedback) feedback.innerHTML=`<p class="notice">Your message is prepared, but has not yet been sent. Press <b>Send</b> in WhatsApp to complete your enquiry. <a href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="text-decoration:underline;font-weight:800">Open WhatsApp again ↗</a></p>`;
  window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');
 }));

 document.querySelectorAll('#calculator-fields input,#calculator-fields select').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('input',updateCalculator);
  el.addEventListener('change',updateCalculator);
 });

 document.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll-calculator]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>document.getElementById('solar-calculator')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})));
}

function updateCalculator(){
 const output=document.getElementById('calc-output'), primary=document.getElementById('calc-primary-saving'), primaryCopy=document.getElementById('calc-primary-copy'), wa=document.getElementById('calc-whatsapp');
 if(!output||!primary||!primaryCopy)return;
 const el=id=>document.getElementById(id), val=id=>Number(el(id)?.value), fmt=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(n);
 const bill=val('calc-bill'), tariff=val('calc-tariff'), roof=val('calc-roof'), sunlight=val('calc-city'), costPerKw=val('calc-cost'), property=el('calc-property')?.value||'Residential';
 const invalid=['calc-bill','calc-tariff','calc-roof','calc-cost'].some(id=>!el(id)?.checkValidity());
 if(invalid||![bill,tariff,roof,sunlight,costPerKw].every(n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0)){
  primary.textContent='₹—';primaryCopy.textContent='Please enter valid values in every field.';
  output.innerHTML='<div class="calc-validation" role="status">Check the values above to calculate your estimate.</div>';
  if(wa)wa.href=WA;return;
 }
 const usableAreaKw=roof/100,monthlyConsumption=bill/tariff;
 const neededKw=monthlyConsumption/(30*sunlight*0.8);
 const capacity=Math.min(neededKw,usableAreaKw);
 const monthlyGeneration=capacity*sunlight*30*.8;
 const monthlySaving=Math.min(bill,monthlyGeneration*tariff);
 const annualSaving=monthlySaving*12;
 const installedCost=capacity*costPerKw;
 const payback=annualSaving>0?installedCost/annualSaving:Infinity;
 const offset=Math.min(100,monthlySaving/bill*100);
 const roofLimited=capacity+0.01<neededKw;
 primary.textContent='₹'+fmt(monthlySaving);
 primaryCopy.textContent=`Up to ₹${fmt(annualSaving)} / year in this illustrative ${property.toLowerCase()} scenario`;
 const items=[
  ['Suggested solar system',capacity.toFixed(1)+' kW','Based on roof space and energy use'],
  ['Monthly energy output',fmt(monthlyGeneration)+' units','After assumed system losses'],
  ['Indicative installation cost','₹'+fmt(installedCost),'Before subsidy or financing'],
  ['Simple payback',Number.isFinite(payback)?payback.toFixed(1)+' years':'—','Cost ÷ estimated annual savings'],
  ['Potential bill offset',Math.round(offset)+'%','Actual bill may retain fixed charges'],
  ['Usable rooftop area',fmt(roof)+' sq ft',roofLimited?'Roof area limits system size':'Area assumption: 100 sq ft / kW']
 ];
 output.innerHTML=items.map(([name,value,help],i)=>`<div class="calc-result-item"><span>${name}</span><b>${value}</b><small>${help}</small></div>`).join('')+(roofLimited?'<div class="calc-roof-note">Your roof area may limit how much of your bill solar can offset.</div>':'');
 if(wa){const message=['Hello Jai Kisaan Solar, I would like to discuss this solar calculator estimate.','',`Property: ${property}`,`Monthly electricity bill: ₹${fmt(bill)}`,`Tariff entered: ₹${tariff}/unit`,`Rooftop area: ${fmt(roof)} sq ft`,`System estimate: ${capacity.toFixed(1)} kW`,`Estimated savings: ₹${fmt(monthlySaving)}/month`,`Illustrative project cost: ₹${fmt(installedCost)}`,`Illustrative payback: ${payback.toFixed(1)} years`,'','Please help me with a site assessment and actual quote.'];wa.href=WA+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(message.join('\n'))}
}

window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',render);
</script></body></html>
